original_query: select coalesce(sum(count_comm), 0) from (   select deptno, count(comm) as count_comm   from emp   group by deptno, mgr) t
rewritten_query:
SELECT count(comm) AS total_count_comm
FROM emp;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Remove the redundant subquery and GROUP BY deptno, mgr. Since sum(count(comm)) across all groups equals count(comm) over the whole table, the inner grouping over ~45M rows (creating ~4.5M groups in a costly HashAggregate) is entirely unnecessary.
The outer COALESCE(sum(...), 0) is only needed for the empty-table case; COUNT(comm) already returns 0 when no rows match, so the COALESCE wrapper can be dropped.
Avoid creating CTEs here: the query has a single aggregate with no joins or redundant subquery computations, so a direct aggregate is optimal.
